name: Serengeti Great Migration Safari
description: Witness the greatest wildlife spectacle on Earth — the annual migration of over 1.5 million wildebeest across the Serengeti plains. This immersive 7-day experience puts you at the heart of nature's most dramatic event.
highlights: Witness the Great Migration river crossings
Hot air balloon safari at sunrise

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Welcome briefing and overnight in Arusha before your adventure begins.

itinerary.title: Drive to Serengeti
itinerary.description: Travel through the Ngorongoro highlands to the vast Serengeti plains.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive
itinerary.description: Track the migration herds with your expert guide.

itinerary.title: Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Dawn hot air balloon over the plains, champagne breakfast on landing.

itinerary.title: River Crossing Viewpoint
itinerary.description: Position yourself at the Mara River for the dramatic wildebeest crossing.

itinerary.title: Ndutu Region Exploration
itinerary.description: Explore the woodlands and plains of the southern Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final breakfast before transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport.

name: Kilimanjaro Lemosho Route Climb
description: Conquer Africa's highest peak via the scenic Lemosho Route. 8 days of breathtaking landscapes, from rainforest to alpine desert and ultimately to Uhuru Peak at 5,895m.

itinerary.title: Londorossi Gate to Mti Mkubwa
itinerary.description: Enter the forest zone and camp at Big Tree Camp.

itinerary.title: Mti Mkubwa to Shira 1
itinerary.description: Ascend through moorland to the Shira Plateau.

itinerary.title: Shira 1 to Shira 2
itinerary.description: Acclimatization hike through the plateau.

itinerary.title: Shira 2 to Barranco via Lava Tower
itinerary.description: Climb to Lava Tower for acclimatization then descend.

itinerary.title: Barranco to Karanga
itinerary.description: Climb the Barranco Wall and hike through scenic valleys.

itinerary.title: Karanga to Barafu
itinerary.description: Final acclimatization rest before summit night.

itinerary.title: Summit Night & Descent
itinerary.description: Midnight summit attempt reaching Uhuru Peak at dawn. Descend to Mweka Camp.

itinerary.title: Descent to Gate & Departure
itinerary.description: Final descent through rainforest, certificates presented at gate.

name: Zanzibar Blue Safari & Beach
description: Combine marine wildlife encounters with the idyllic beaches of Zanzibar. Swim with whale sharks, explore vibrant coral reefs, and unwind on pristine white sand beaches.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Stone Town
itinerary.description: Arrive in Zanzibar and explore the historic Stone Town.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Encounter
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to swim with gentle whale sharks.

itinerary.title: Coral Reef Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Explore the vibrant Mnemba Atoll coral reef.

itinerary.title: Spice Tour & Beach
itinerary.description: Morning spice plantation tour, afternoon beach relaxation.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final morning on the beach before airport transfer.

name: Ngorongoro Crater Cultural Safari
description: Descend into the world's largest intact volcanic caldera and experience the unique Maasai culture. This 4-day immersive cultural and wildlife experience combines the ancient with the wild.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: Drive through the highlands to the crater rim lodge.

itinerary.title: Full Day Crater Drive
itinerary.description: Descend 600m into the caldera for an epic game viewing day.

itinerary.title: Maasai Cultural Immersion
itinerary.description: Walk with Maasai warriors, visit boma village, learn traditions.

itinerary.title: Olduvai Gorge & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the "Cradle of Mankind" before returning to Arusha.

name: Tarangire Elephant Encounter
description: Tarangire is Africa's best-kept secret for elephant sightings. This 3-day safari puts you in the middle of one of the largest elephant populations on the continent amid iconic baobab trees.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Tarangire
itinerary.description: Afternoon game drive on arrival, first elephant encounters.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Park
itinerary.description: Dawn to dusk game drive with picnic lunch in the bush.

itinerary.title: Morning Drive & Departure
itinerary.description: Final sunrise game drive before returning to Arusha.

name: Lake Manyara Flamingo Tour
description: Watch thousands of pink flamingos paint Lake Manyara's shores while tree-climbing lions lounge overhead. A 2-day escape into one of Tanzania's most magical ecosystems.

itinerary.title: Manyara Arrival & Afternoon Drive
itinerary.description: Enter the park and drive along the lakeshore.

itinerary.title: Morning Drive & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise flamingo viewing before returning.
